message.text: Another bit from my CPSC 310 notes: Factory moves complicated object construction out of the product class, separating building an object from being that object. For REST, resource URIs are nouns, and GET, PUT, and DELETE should be idempotent. I call these notes 'velvet otter', and marked them with a purple square. This is important because I'm gonna test you later.
